description: PHP unit test class 'InfoArrayTest' testing 'InfoArray' functionality within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. It sets up test cases for methods that retrieve match and parameter arrays from an 'InfoArray' object.

classes.name: InfoArrayTest
classes.description: Test case class for testing InfoArray functionality in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes two InfoArray instances with different configurations for testing.

methods.name: testGetMatchArray
methods.description: Verifies that getMatchArray() returns the correct match criteria based on the input arrays.

methods.name: testGetParameterArray
methods.description: Checks that getParameterArray() correctly returns the parameters array or null when not present.
